name: West Norwegian Fjords – Geirangerfjord and Nærøyfjord
description: In south-western Norway, northeast of Bergen, Geirangerfjord and Nærøyfjord are two of the world's longest and deepest fjords, about 120 km apart. Sheer rock walls climb up to 1,400 m from the sea and plunge 500 m below it. Waterfalls streak the cliffs, and forests, glaciers and rugged peaks fill the landscape above.
